description: GLM 5.3 FlashX Legal is Z.AI's model trained for legal document analysis, contract review, legal reasoning and initial drafts. It accepts text and images and returns text, with always-on reasoning, tool calling, JSON output, a 1M-token context window and up to 131,072 output tokens. External legal databases and document-editing tools require your own integrations.
name: GLM 5.3 FlashX Legal
